main_text.p: opinio, verè ἱλασμὸν[?] Christi sa-crificium, imperfectionis cu-iusdam insimulet. Confistere posse (sat scio) contendunt satisfactionem utramque παθητὴν[?], & humanam: Quarum alteram Bonaventura plenam, semiplenam alteram appellauit: Et haec verba quidem sunt; sed dicant mihi sophi-stae; Quod plenum est, annon continet in se quod semi-plenum? Aut quid hoc opus vbi illud suppetit? quicquam-ne denique addi potest perfecto? At haec duo cautiores quidam nec opponi forte volunt, nec subordinari: Pudet enim dicere quid Suarez, quid Duran-dus,Cit. Cajf.

page.notes: The Greek words are only partly legible in the scan; the first is read as ἱλασμὸν with doubt, and the second as παθητὴν with doubt. The marginal note reads "Cit. Cajf." The foot line "H dus," is partly cut off; it is set as a catchword with doubt, and the "H" is unclear. The first paragraph continues from the previous page.
